items.title: OCULUS maps for evaluating ortho-k: Epithelial Reshaping Power Map Learn how to obtain a more accurate evaluation of refractive change from ortho-k with the recently released map in the OCULUS Pentacam. Read Full Article

items.title: Evaluating refractive change from ortho-k: which map to use? This article goes through what corneal topography maps mean geometrically to aid clinical decision making. Read Full Article
items.summary_es: Artículo que analiza la interpretación de mapas de topografía corneal en ortoqueratología para optimizar la toma de decisiones clínicas, explicando el significado geométrico de diferentes representaciones topográficas en el seguimiento de cambios refractivos.
